item.description:
Hi! Sometime ago I posted this in a now-locked request thread, so here's again, with a working link.
Here you can find all leaked instrumentals from Lana Del Rey's discography.
Includes:
  • Born to Die (All album instrumentals) [128, 160, 320 kbps]
  • Paradise (All album instrumentals, except "Blue Velvet" and "Burning Desire") [160, 320 kbps]
  • Ultraviolence (All album instrumentals, except "Is This Happiness" and "Flipside") [160, 320 kbps]
  • Honeymoon (All album instrumentals, except "Burnt Norton interlude" and "Don't Let Me Be Misunderstood") [320 kbps]
  • Lust for Life (All album instrumentals, except "When the World Was at War, We Kept Dancing") [160 kbps]
  • Norman Fucking Rockwell! (All album instrumentals, except "Bartender") [320 kbps]
  • Chemtrails over the Country Club (All album instrumentals) [320 kbps]
  • "Nectar of the Gods" and "Cherry Blossom" (only instrumentals from Blue Banisters to be leaked to date) [320 kbps]
  • Did you know that there's a tunnel under Ocean Blvd (All album instrumentals) [320 kbps]
  • "Say Yes to Heaven" [Lossless WAV 24bit]
I didn't include instrumentals for unreleased songs because I'm not sure of their legitimacy.
Enjoy!
